evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 from about 28,800 ppm down to 15 ppm, then it held at 3-6 ppm.
During the ramp the thermocouple stayed within about 0.5 °C of the setpoint, and heater power rose smoothly.
Temperature overshot to 761.4 °C at the start of growth and was back to 752.5 °C by the next reading. Heater power dropped to 40-42%, which fits holding a steady temperature rather than ramping.
Pressure is steady near 760 Torr and argon flow is on its 100 sccm setpoint.

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample exists yet. Remaining growth-stage readings should also confirm the temperature settles at 750 °C.
